title: Two Black Holes May Collide Within 100 Years

scenes.text: Two supermassive black holes may collide within a hundred years.
They're in a galaxy called Markarian 501.
Each weighs hundreds of millions of suns.
They circle each other every 121 days.
Astronomers tracked their jets for 23 years to find them.
But the galaxy is 464 million light-years away.
So we're seeing it as it looked 464 million years ago.

description:
Two supermassive black holes may collide within a hundred years.
Astronomers tracking the jets of Markarian 501 for 23 years found signs of a pair orbiting every 121 days, though the detection is not yet conclusive.
Would you want to watch it happen?
first_comment: Bonus: the light we see left that galaxy 464 million years ago. Do you think the collision already happened?
